test_title: PYST 01: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters E, R, A, L, O and T. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face E?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9c578025143531543e193196048bb4aa2f0715d8bad9b3597fcb38aa4e64d0.png]
solution: The logic followed here is :- As R is common on both the dices, it is clear that L, T, O, and A are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. E will be opposite to it.
